aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { scope:aub_payer = { has_character_flag = aub_funding_treasury_only } }
		scope:aub_payer = {
			has_treasury = yes
			treasury >= $GOLD$
		}
	}
	trigger_else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aub_payer = { has_character_flag = aub_funding_personal_only } }
		scope:aub_payer = { gold >= $GOLD$ }
	}
	trigger_else = {
		scope:aub_payer = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					has_treasury = yes
					treasury >= $GOLD$
				}
				gold >= $GOLD$
			}
		}
	}
}

	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_barracks_requirement_terrain = yes
	building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
		LEVEL = 01
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_barracks
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_barracks
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_barracks
		}
	}
	building_requirement_tribal = no
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_cereal_fields_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_cereal_fields_requirement_terrain = yes
	building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
		LEVEL = 01
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:holder.culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = vegetarian_next_level_cereal_fields
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_crop_rotation
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = vegetarian_next_level_cereal_fields
		}
	}
}

				}

			LEVEL = 01
		}

				LEVEL = 01
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_trade_ports
				}
			}
		}
		culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_crop_rotation
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_trade_ports
		}
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
}

	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_fortification
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_motte
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_fortification
		}
	}
	building_requirement_tribal = no
}

					is_holy_site_of = scope:holder.faith
				}
			}

				CHARACTER = scope:holder
			}
		}
	}

		}

	}
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_farm_estates_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	OR = {
		building_farm_estates_requirement_terrain = yes
		AND = {
			has_building_or_higher = pastures_04
			culture = {
				has_cultural_parameter = farm_estates_pastures_unlock
			}
		}
		building_paddy_fields_requirement_terrain = yes
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	OR = {
		AND = {
			building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
				LEVEL = 01
			}
			scope:holder.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_crop_rotation
			}
			building_farm_estates_requirement_terrain = yes
		}
		AND = {
			has_building_or_higher = pastures_04
			culture = {
				has_cultural_parameter = farm_estates_pastures_unlock
			}
		}
		AND = {
			building_paddy_fields_requirement_terrain = yes
			scope:holder.culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_champa_rice
			}
			building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
				LEVEL = 01
			}
		}
	}
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_guild_halls_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	has_building_or_higher = city_01
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	culture = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_guild_halls
				}
			}
			has_innovation = innovation_crop_rotation
		}
	}
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_guild_halls_03_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	# vanilla can_construct
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_guild_halls
				}
			}
		}
		culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
		}
		has_building_or_higher = city_02
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_crop_rotation
		}
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_guild_halls
		}
		has_building_or_higher = city_01
	}
}

				text = holy_site_building_trigger

	}

aub_can_upgrade_to_holy_site_canterbury_cathedral_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla is_enabled
	custom_description = {
		text = holy_site_christian_or_holy_site_trigger
		OR = {
			christianity_or_syncretic_with_christianity_trigger = {
				CHARACTER = scope:holder
			}
			custom_description = {
				text = holy_site_building_trigger
				barony = {
					is_holy_site_of = scope:holder.faith
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	# vanilla can_construct
	OR = {
		christianity_or_syncretic_with_christianity_trigger = {
			CHARACTER = scope:holder
		}

aub_can_upgrade_to_military_camps_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_military_camps_requirement_terrain = yes
	building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
		LEVEL = 01
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_military_camps
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_barracks
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_military_camps
		}
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	building_requirement_tribal = no
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_monastic_schools_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:holder.faith = {
				NOT = {
					has_doctrine_parameter = monastic_schools_allowed_in_every_holding_type
				}
			}
		}
		has_holding_type = church_holding
	}
	building_requirement_castle_city_church_temple_citadel_tribe = {
		LEVEL = 01
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	scope:holder.culture = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_monasteries
				}
			}

aub_can_upgrade_to_monastic_schools_03_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:holder.faith = {
				NOT = {
					has_doctrine_parameter = monastic_schools_allowed_in_every_holding_type
				}
			}
		}
		has_holding_type = church_holding
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_monasteries
				}
			}
		}
		culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
		}
		building_requirement_castle_city_church_temple_citadel_tribe = {
			LEVEL = 02
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_city_planning
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_monasteries
		}
		building_requirement_castle_city_church_temple_citadel_tribe = {
			LEVEL = 01
		}
	}
}

	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	# vanilla can_construct
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:holder.culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = rice_cultivators_next_level_paddy_fields
				}
			}
		}
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
			LEVEL = 03
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_guilds
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = rice_cultivators_next_level_paddy_fields
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
		}
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
			LEVEL = 02
		}
	}
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_palace_of_ctesiphon_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct
	scope:holder = {
		AND = {
			OR = {
				zoroastrian_or_syncretic_with_eastern_trigger = {
					CHARACTER = scope:holder
				}
				faith = faith:manichean
				faith = faith:nestorian
				faith = faith:hellenic_pagan
			}
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
			top_liege = this
		}
	}
}

			}
		}
	}

aub_can_upgrade_to_qutb_minar_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla is_enabled
	custom_description = {
		text = holy_site_muslim_or_holy_site_trigger
		OR = {
			islam_or_syncretic_with_islam_trigger = {
				CHARACTER = scope:holder
			}
			custom_description = {
				text = holy_site_building_trigger
				barony = {
					is_holy_site_of = scope:holder.faith
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	# vanilla can_construct
	custom_description = {
		text = holy_site_muslim_or_holy_site_trigger
		OR = {
			barony = {
				is_holy_site_of = scope:holder.faith
			}
			islam_or_syncretic_with_islam_trigger = {
				CHARACTER = scope:holder
			}
		}
	}
	scope:holder = {
		culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_burhs
		}

aub_can_upgrade_to_smiths_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_smiths_requirement_terrain = yes
	building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
		LEVEL = 01
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_smiths
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_barracks
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_smiths
		}
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	building_requirement_tribal = no
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_smiths_03_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_smiths_requirement_terrain = yes
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only

	# vanilla can_construct
	trigger_if = {

			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_smiths
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_burhs
		}
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
			LEVEL = 02
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_smiths
		}
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
			LEVEL = 01
		}
	}
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_temple_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	scope:holder = {
		NOT = {
			government_has_flag = government_is_mandala
		}
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	NOT = {
		scope:holder = {
			has_character_modifier = tgp_rebuilder_modifier
		}
	}
	# vanilla can_construct
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:holder.culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = temple_next_level
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = temple_next_level
			has_innovation = innovation_city_planning
		}
	}
}

			has_innovation = innovation_hoardings
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
			LEVEL = 02
		}
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_fortification
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_battlements
		}
	}
}

aub_can_upgrade_to_watermills_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	OR = {
		building_watermills_requirement_terrain = yes
		AND = {
			has_building_or_higher = logging_camps_04
			culture = {
				has_cultural_parameter = watermills_forestries_unlock
			}
		}
	}
	building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
		LEVEL = 01
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_showing_failures_only
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	# vanilla can_construct
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				scope:holder.culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_w_mills
				}
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = watermills_forestries_unlock
				}
			}
		}
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_windmills
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		OR = {
			culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_windmills
			}
			culture = {
				has_cultural_parameter = next_level_w_mills
				has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
			}
			AND = {
				has_building_or_higher = logging_camps_04
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = watermills_forestries_unlock
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		OR = {
			christianity_or_syncretic_with_christianity_trigger = {
				CHARACTER = scope:holder
			}
			custom_description = {
				text = holy_site_building_trigger
				barony = {
					is_holy_site_of = scope:holder.faith
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	# vanilla can_construct
	scope:holder.culture = {
		has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
	}
}

		building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
			LEVEL = 03
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_w_mills
		}
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = {
			LEVEL = 02
		}
	}
}
